name: Vidyaranyapura
tagline: An established neighbourhood; an address worth reading closely.
description: Vidyaranyapura is an established residential search area in northern Bengaluru, with local streets, schools and the Sri Kalika Durga Parameshwari Temple as a recognised landmark. Some new projects marketed under Vidyaranyapura lie in Chikkabettahalli towards Yelahanka. Keep that actual village address visible when comparing a home.
